# Stressi

> Stressi is a privacy-first stress and recovery app for iPhone and Android. It reads
> heart rate variability, resting heart rate, sleep and activity from Apple Health or
> Health Connect and turns them into one daily "Body State" score, an explanation of
> what changed, and a short plan for the day. All processing happens on device; there
> is no account and no cloud sync of health data.

## What it does

- **Body State score**: one daily number built from recovery, stress load, sleep quality,
  heart rate variability, resting heart rate and recent activity. Compared against the
  user's own recent baseline, not a population average.
- **Why it changed**: names the specific signals that moved the score (sleep debt, an HRV
  drop, a hard session the day before).
- **Today Plan**: short, specific next steps rather than generic rest advice.
- **Camera heart rate**: takes a heart rate and HRV reading with the phone camera when no
  wearable is available.

## Platforms and requirements

- iOS 16.0 or later, reading from Apple Health. An Apple Watch improves accuracy but is
  not required.
- Android 14 or later, reading from Health Connect. Any Health Connect compatible
  wearable works.
- Interface languages: English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese,
  Korean, Chinese.

## Privacy

Health readings are processed and stored on the device. There is no account, no email
signup, no cloud sync of health data, no advertising SDKs and no tracking across other
apps or websites. Deleting the app deletes the data.

The one exception is crash reporting: when the app crashes, a diagnostic report goes to
Firebase Crashlytics so the bug can be fixed. Crash reports carry the code location,
device model, OS and app version, and a random per-install identifier. They never contain
health data, and they are not used for advertising or cross-app tracking.

## Pricing

- Free: daily Body State score, why-it-changed explanations, Today Plan, 7-day trends.
- Stressi Pro: USD 3.99/month or USD 24.99/year (7-day free trial on the annual plan).
  Adds 30, 90 and 365-day trends, deeper patterns and triggers, guided programmes,
  reports, exports, journal correlations, guided breathing and advanced widgets.
  Prices vary by country.

## Important limitation

Stressi is a wellness app, not a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat or prevent
any condition and is not a substitute for advice from a qualified clinician.
